# 1. METADATA | 元数据
# Project identification for LLM context | LLM 快速识别项目信息

PROJECT_NAME: DevUI (ng-devui)
FRAMEWORK: Angular
LANGUAGE: TypeScript
VERSION: 18.0.0
ANGULAR_VERSION: 21.1.0 (实际使用版本，DevUI 18.0.0 声明支持 Angular ^18.0.0)
LAST_UPDATE: 2026-02-07
RESTRICTION_LEVEL: STRICT  # Enforces strict compliance - no violations allowed | 严格模式，禁止所有违规写法
OFFICIAL_DOCS: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/get-start
GITHUB_REPO: https://github.com/DevCloudFE/ng-devui
NPM_PACKAGE: ng-devui

DESIGN_PRINCIPLES:
- Efficient (高效): Simplify processes and lower barriers for WYSIWYG results.
- Open (开放): Embrace community contributions and diverse scenarios.
- Credible (可信): Deliver reliable, consistent, and secure experiences.
- Fun (乐趣): Create engaging, immersive interactions.

# 2. AI GENERATION CONSTRAINTS | AI 生成强制约束
# HIGHEST PRIORITY RULES | 核心规则，优先级最高

## 2.1 Component Usage Constraints | 组件使用约束

1. **Only use official library components | 仅使用官方组件**
   - Importing and using components from ng-devui is MANDATORY
   - Do NOT create custom implementations using native HTML elements (div, button, input, etc.)
   - 仅允许导入并使用 ng-devui 暴露的官方组件，禁止手写原生 HTML 标签重构组件
   - Example: Use `<d-button>` instead of `<button>`, use `<d-text-input>` instead of `<input>`

2. **Strict import paths | 严格导入路径**
   ```typescript
   // ✅ CORRECT - Import specific module
   import { ButtonModule } from 'ng-devui/button';
   import { CardModule } from 'ng-devui/card';
   import { TextInputModule } from 'ng-devui/text-input';
   import { FormModule } from 'ng-devui/form';
   import { RadioModule } from 'ng-devui/radio';
   import { IconModule } from 'ng-devui/icon';
   import { LayoutModule } from 'ng-devui/layout';
   
   // ✅ CORRECT - Import all modules (NgModule only)
   import { DevUIModule } from 'ng-devui';
   
   // ❌ WRONG - Do not use relative paths or custom aliases
   // import { ButtonModule } from './components/button';
   ```

3. **Module import in standalone components | Standalone 组件中的模块导入**
   ```typescript
   // Standalone Component Pattern
   import { Component } from '@angular/core';
   import { ButtonModule } from 'ng-devui/button';
   
   @Component({
     selector: 'app-example',
     imports: [ButtonModule],  // Import module in standalone component
     template: `<d-button bsStyle="primary">按钮</d-button>`
   })
   export class ExampleComponent {}
   ```

4. **Known compatibility issue: d-form in standalone components | 已知兼容性问题：standalone 组件中的 d-form**
   - ⚠️ `d-form` container component may not work in Angular 21 standalone components
   - ✅ Use native `<form>` element with DevUI form sub-components instead:
   ```html
   <!-- ✅ CORRECT - Hybrid approach for forms -->
   <form class="devui-form">
     <d-form-item>
       <d-form-label>标签</d-form-label>
       <d-form-control>
         <d-text-input></d-text-input>
       </d-form-control>
     </d-form-item>
   </form>
   
   <!-- ❌ AVOID - d-form may not work in standalone components -->
   <!-- <d-form>
     <d-form-item>...</d-form-item>
   </d-form> -->
   ```

5. **No style overrides | 禁止样式覆盖**
   - Inheritance, rewriting, or overriding of component built-in styles is FORBIDDEN
   - Never use `!important` syntax
   - 禁止继承、重写、覆盖组件库内置样式，不允许使用 !important 语法
   - Use component props/inputs to customize appearance instead

## 2.2 Styling Constraints | 样式约束
# Design Tokens Only - Zero Hardcoding | 绑定设计令牌，杜绝硬编码

1. **No inline styles or hardcoded values | 禁止内联样式和硬编码**
   - ❌ Inline `[style]` or `[ngStyle]` attributes for component styling
   - ❌ Hardcoded colors (#xxx, rgb, rgba) in templates
   - ❌ Hardcoded dimensions (px, rem without variables) for component sizing
   - ❌ Hardcoded border-radius, shadows, spacing
   - ✅ Use component props: `bsStyle`, `bsSize`, `cssClass` etc.
   - ✅ Use design tokens via CSS variables (see section 3)

2. **Design token enforcement | 强制使用设计令牌**
   - ✅ Component official Props/Inputs (bsStyle, bsSize, etc.)
   - ✅ Design token CSS variables (see section 3.4)
   - ✅ Theme configuration via DevUI theme system
   - ✅ Component built-in style classes

3. **No custom stylesheets for components | 禁止为组件创建自定义样式表**
   - Do NOT create independent CSS/SCSS files to override component styles
   - 不允许编写独立的 CSS/SCSS 文件来覆盖组件样式
   - Use component configuration props instead
   - Exception: Custom layout containers may use CSS with design tokens

4. **Built-in responsiveness only | 仅使用内置响应式规则**
   - Use component library's built-in responsive props and breakpoint rules
   - 响应式适配仅使用组件库内置的响应式属性/工具类

## 2.3 Code Standards Constraints | 代码规范约束

1. **TypeScript strict mode | TypeScript 严格模式**
   - Use TypeScript type definitions throughout
   - Adhere to project ESLint and Stylelint rules
   - 统一使用 TS 类型定义，遵循项目 ESLint/Stylelint 规则

2. **Stable APIs only | 仅使用稳定版 API**
   - Never use deprecated Props or methods
   - Only use stable, documented APIs
   - 禁用组件库已废弃的 Props/方法，仅使用稳定版 API
   - Deprecated: `bsPosition` in Button (use ButtonGroup instead)

3. **Standardized event handlers | 标准化事件处理**
   - Follow Angular event binding conventions: `(eventName)="handler($event)"`
   - Use component-specific event outputs (e.g., `btnClick`, `valueChange`)
   - 交互逻辑遵循 Angular 事件绑定规范

4. **Animation support required | 需要动画支持**
   - Must import `provideAnimations()` in app.config.ts
   - DevUI components require Angular Animations module
   - 必须在 app.config.ts 中导入 provideAnimations()

---

## 3.4 CSS Variables | CSS 变量
# Use these CSS variables in custom styles | 在自定义样式中使用这些 CSS 变量

CSS_VARIABLES: {
  "Colors": {
    "--devui-primary": "#5E7CE0",
    "--devui-danger": "#F66F6A",
    "--devui-success": "#3AC295",
    "--devui-warning": "#FA9841",
    "--devui-base-bg": "#FFFFFF (container) or #F2F3F5 (page)",
    "--devui-text-primary": "#252B3A",
    "--devui-text-secondary": "#71757F",
    "--devui-text-tertiary": "#BABBC0",
    "--devui-text-disabled": "#CFD0D3",
    "--devui-text-white": "#FFFFFF",
    "--devui-border": "#ADB0B8"
  },
  "Spacing": {
    "--devui-spacing-xs": "4px",
    "--devui-spacing-sm": "8px",
    "--devui-spacing-md": "16px",
    "--devui-spacing-lg": "24px",
    "--devui-spacing-xl": "32px"
  },
  "Typography": {
    "--devui-font-family": "Helvetica, Arial, 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'HarmonyOS Sans SC', sans-serif",
    "--devui-font-size-h2": "24px",
    "--devui-font-size-h3": "20px",
    "--devui-font-size-h4": "16px",
    "--devui-font-size-body": "12px",
    "--devui-font-size-small": "12px",
    "--devui-font-weight-normal": "400",
    "--devui-font-weight-medium": "500",
    "--devui-font-weight-semibold": "600",
    "--devui-line-height-base": "1.5"
  },
  "Layout": {
    "--devui-border-radius-lg": "8px",
    "--devui-shadow-card": "0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)"
  }
}

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  /* ✅ CORRECT - Use CSS variables */
  .custom-container {
    background-color: var(--devui-base-bg, #FFFFFF);
    padding: var(--devui-spacing-lg, 24px);
    border-radius: var(--devui-border-radius-lg, 8px);
    color: var(--devui-text-primary, #1D2129);
  }
  
  /* ❌ WRONG - Hardcoded values */
  .custom-container {
    background-color: #FFFFFF;
    padding: 24px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: #1D2129;
  }

COMPONENT: Button
IMPORT_PATH: ng-devui/button
SELECTOR: d-button
MODULE: ButtonModule
DOCS: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/button/demo

CORE_PROPS: {
  "bsStyle": "common | primary | text | text-dark | danger | success | warning",
  "bsSize": "lg | md | sm | xs",
  "type": "button | submit | reset",
  "disabled": "boolean",
  "icon": "string",
  "showLoading": "boolean",
  "bordered": "boolean",
  "shape": "circle",
  "width": "string",
  "autofocus": "boolean"
}

OUTPUTS: {
  "btnClick": "EventEmitter<MouseEvent>"
}

SEMANTIC_NODES: root(根容器), button-element(按钮元素), icon(图标容器), content(文本区域)

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  <d-button bsStyle="primary" bsSize="md" (btnClick)="handleClick()">
    主要按钮
  </d-button>
  
  <d-button bsStyle="success" [disabled]="isDisabled">
    <d-icon name="icon-check"></d-icon>
    成功按钮
  </d-button>
  
  <d-button bsStyle="common" bsSize="sm">取消</d-button>

FORBIDDEN: [
  "使用原生 <button> 标签",
  "使用 bsPosition (已废弃，使用 ButtonGroup 代替)",
  "内联样式覆盖按钮样式"
]

---

COMPONENT: Card
IMPORT_PATH: ng-devui/card
SELECTOR: d-card
MODULE: CardModule
DOCS: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/card/demo

CORE_PROPS: {
  "interactive": "boolean"
}

SUB_COMPONENTS: {
  "d-card-header": "CardHeaderComponent",
  "d-card-title": "CardTitleDirective",
  "d-card-subtitle": "CardSubtitleDirective",
  "d-card-content": "CardContentDirective",
  "d-card-actions": "CardActionsDirective",
  "d-card-avatar": "CardAvatarDirective",
  "d-card-meta": "CardMetaDirective",
  "d-card-extend": "CardExtendComponent"
}

CARD_ACTIONS_PROPS: {
  "align": "start | end | center | spaceBetween"
}

SEMANTIC_NODES: root(根容器), header(头部), body(主体), footer(底部), actions(操作区)

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  <d-card>
    <d-card-header>
      <d-card-title>卡片标题</d-card-title>
      <d-card-subtitle>副标题</d-card-subtitle>
    </d-card-header>
    <d-card-content>
      卡片内容区域
    </d-card-content>
    <d-card-actions align="end">
      <d-button bsStyle="primary">操作</d-button>
    </d-card-actions>
  </d-card>
  
  <d-card [interactive]="true" (click)="handleCardClick()">
    <d-card-content>
      可交互卡片
    </d-card-content>
  </d-card>

FORBIDDEN: [
  "使用原生 div 创建卡片布局",
  "自定义 CSS 覆盖卡片样式"
]

COMPONENT: TextInput
IMPORT_PATH: ng-devui/text-input
SELECTOR: d-text-input
MODULE: TextInputModule
DOCS: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/text-input/demo

CORE_PROPS: {
  "placeholder": "string",
  "disabled": "boolean",
  "readonly": "boolean",
  "size": "lg | md | sm",
  "maxLength": "number",
  "cssClass": "string",
  "autofocus": "boolean",
  "value": "string"
}

OUTPUTS: {
  "valueChange": "EventEmitter<string>",
  "focus": "EventEmitter<FocusEvent>",
  "blur": "EventEmitter<FocusEvent>"
}

SEMANTIC_NODES: root(根容器), input-wrapper(输入框包装器), input-element(输入元素)

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  <d-text-input 
    placeholder="请输入内容"
    [disabled]="false"
    size="md"
    [(ngModel)]="inputValue"
    (valueChange)="onValueChange($event)">
  </d-text-input>
  
  <!-- With icon wrapper -->
  <div class="search-input-wrapper">
    <d-icon name="icon-search" class="search-icon"></d-icon>
    <d-text-input
      [(ngModel)]="searchValue"
      placeholder="请输入关键字搜索"
      class="search-input">
    </d-text-input>
  </div>

FORBIDDEN: [
  "使用原生 <input> 标签",
  "硬编码颜色和尺寸值"
]

---

COMPONENT: Form (Sub-components)
IMPORT_PATH: ng-devui/form
MODULE: FormModule
DOCS: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/form/demo

⚠️ IMPORTANT: d-form container may not work in Angular 21 standalone components. Use native <form> with DevUI sub-components.

SUB_COMPONENTS: {
  "d-form-item": "FormItemComponent",
  "d-form-label": "FormLabelDirective",
  "d-form-control": "FormControlDirective"
}

FORM_ITEM_PROPS: {
  "labelSize": "sm | md | lg",
  "labelWidth": "string",
  "labelAlign": "start | center | end"
}

SEMANTIC_NODES: form-item(表单项), form-label(标签), form-control(控件)

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  <!-- ✅ CORRECT - Hybrid approach -->
  <form class="devui-form">
    <d-form-item>
      <d-form-label class="required-label">* 用户名:</d-form-label>
      <d-form-control>
        <d-text-input 
          [(ngModel)]="username"
          name="username"
          placeholder="请输入用户名">
        </d-text-input>
      </d-form-control>
    </d-form-item>
    
    <d-form-item>
      <d-form-label>来源:</d-form-label>
      <d-form-control>
        <d-radio 
          *ngFor="let option of options"
          [value]="option.value"
          [(ngModel)]="selectedValue"
          name="source">
          {{ option.label }}
        </d-radio>
      </d-form-control>
    </d-form-item>
  </form>

FORBIDDEN: [
  "使用原生 <form> 标签替代 d-form (仅在 standalone 组件中允许)",
  "自定义表单布局样式",
  "在 standalone 组件中使用 d-form 容器（使用原生 form 代替）"
]

  "value": "any",
  "name": "string",
  "disabled": "boolean",
  "cssClass": "string"
}

OUTPUTS: {
  "change": "EventEmitter<any>"
}

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  <d-radio 
    *ngFor="let option of options"
    [value]="option.value"
    [(ngModel)]="selectedValue"
    name="radioGroup">
    {{ option.label }}
  </d-radio>
  
  <d-radio 
    value="option1"
    [(ngModel)]="value"
    name="group1"
    [disabled]="false">
    选项1
  </d-radio>

COMPONENT: Modal
IMPORT_PATH: ng-devui/modal
SELECTOR: d-modal
MODULE: ModalModule
DOCS: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/modal/demo

CORE_PROPS: {
  "id": "string",
  "width": "string",
  "zIndex": "number",
  "backdropCloseable": "boolean",
  "draggable": "boolean",
  "placement": "center | top | bottom",
  "showAnimation": "boolean",
  "escapable": "boolean",
  "cssClass": "string"
}

SUB_COMPONENTS: {
  "d-modal-header": "ModalHeaderComponent",
  "d-modal-body": "ModalBodyComponent",
  "d-modal-footer": "ModalFooterComponent"
}

SERVICE: DialogService (for programmatic modal creation)

SEMANTIC_NODES: root(根容器), backdrop(背景遮罩), modal-container(模态框容器), header(头部), body(主体), footer(底部)

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  <!-- Template Modal -->
  <d-modal #modal [backdropCloseable]="true">
    <d-modal-header>
      <h4>模态框标题</h4>
    </d-modal-header>
    <d-modal-body>
      模态框内容
    </d-modal-body>
    <d-modal-footer>
      <d-button (btnClick)="modal.hide()">取消</d-button>
      <d-button bsStyle="primary" (btnClick)="handleConfirm()">确认</d-button>
    </d-modal-footer>
  </d-modal>
  
  <!-- Service Modal -->
  this.dialogService.open({
    id: 'my-modal',
    width: '600px',
    // ...
  });

FORBIDDEN: [
  "使用原生 dialog 元素",
  "自定义模态框定位和动画"
]

COMPONENT: Pagination
IMPORT_PATH: ng-devui/pagination
SELECTOR: d-pagination
MODULE: PaginationModule
DOCS: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/pagination/demo

CORE_PROPS: {
  "total": "number",
  "pageSize": "number",
  "pageIndex": "number",
  "pageSizeOptions": "number[]",
  "canChangePageSize": "boolean",
  "canJumpPage": "boolean",
  "showJumpButton": "boolean",
  "size": "lg | md | sm"
}

OUTPUTS: {
  "pageIndexChange": "EventEmitter<number>",
  "pageSizeChange": "EventEmitter<number>"
}

SEMANTIC_NODES: root(根容器), page-size-selector(每页条数选择器), page-list(页码列表), jump-input(跳转输入)

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  <d-pagination
    [total]="100"
    [pageSize]="10"
    [pageIndex]="currentPage"
    [canChangePageSize]="true"
    [canJumpPage]="true"
    (pageIndexChange)="onPageChange($event)"
    (pageSizeChange)="onPageSizeChange($event)">
  </d-pagination>

FORBIDDEN: [
  "使用原生分页控件",
  "自定义分页样式"
]

---

COMPONENT: Toast
IMPORT_PATH: ng-devui/toast
SELECTOR: d-toast
MODULE: ToastModule
SERVICE: ToastService
DOCS: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/toast/demo

SERVICE_METHODS: {
  "open": "(options: ToastOptions) => ToastRef",
  "success": "(message: string, options?: ToastOptions) => ToastRef",
  "error": "(message: string, options?: ToastOptions) => ToastRef",
  "warning": "(message: string, options?: ToastOptions) => ToastRef",
  "info": "(message: string, options?: ToastOptions) => ToastRef"
}

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |
  // Service Usage
  constructor(private toastService: ToastService) {}
  
  showSuccess() {
    this.toastService.success('操作成功！');
  }
  
  showError() {
    this.toastService.error('操作失败！', {
      life: 3000,
      lifeMode: 'global'
    });
  }

FORBIDDEN: [
  "使用原生 alert 或自定义提示组件",
  "自定义 Toast 样式和位置"
]

}

USAGE_EXAMPLE: |

    内容区域
  </div>

  showLoading() {
    this.loadingService.open();
  }

    this.loadingService.close();
  }

# 5. FORBIDDEN LIST | 禁用清单
# LLM must NEVER use these syntaxes/APIs | LLM 绝对禁止使用的语法/API

FORBIDDEN_LIST: [
  "内联 [style] 或 [ngStyle] 属性覆盖组件样式 | Inline [style] or [ngStyle] attributes for component styling",
  "硬编码颜色值（#、rgb、rgba）| Hardcoded color values",
  "硬编码尺寸数值（px/rem 无变量）| Hardcoded dimensions without variables",
  "!important 样式优先级 | !important style priority",
  "组件库废弃API | Deprecated component APIs: bsPosition in Button (use ButtonGroup instead)",
  "自定义原生HTML组件替代库组件 | Custom native HTML replacing library components: <button>, <input>, <select>, <table>, <form> (except form in standalone components)",
  "自定义 CSS/SCSS 文件覆盖组件样式 | Custom CSS/SCSS files to override component styles",
  "不使用组件库模块导入 | Not importing component modules",
  "在 standalone 组件中直接使用 DevUIModule (应使用具体组件模块) | Using DevUIModule directly in standalone components (use specific component modules instead)",
  "在 standalone 组件中使用 d-form 容器（使用原生 form + DevUI 子组件代替）| Using d-form container in standalone components (use native form + DevUI sub-components instead)"
]

LINT_RULES: [

# 7. INSTALLATION & SETUP | 安装与配置

## 7.1 Installation | 安装

```bash
npm install ng-devui @angular/animations
```

## 7.2 Configuration | 配置

### app.config.ts
```typescript
import { ApplicationConfig } from '@angular/core';
import { provideAnimations } from '@angular/platform-browser/animations';

export const appConfig: ApplicationConfig = {
  providers: [
    provideAnimations()  // Required for DevUI components
  ]
};
```

### angular.json
```json
{
  "styles": [
    "src/styles.css",
    "node_modules/ng-devui/devui.min.css"
  ]
}
```

### Standalone Component Usage
```typescript
import { Component } from '@angular/core';
import { ButtonModule } from 'ng-devui/button';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-example',
  imports: [ButtonModule],
  template: `<d-button bsStyle="primary">按钮</d-button>`
})
export class ExampleComponent {}
```

### NgModule Usage
```typescript
import { NgModule } from '@angular/core';
import { DevUIModule } from 'ng-devui';

@NgModule({
  imports: [DevUIModule],
  // ...
})
export class AppModule {}
```

---

# 8. VERSION COMPATIBILITY | 版本兼容性

## 8.1 Current Version Status | 当前版本状态

- **Angular**: 21.1.0 (实际使用)
- **DevUI**: 18.0.0 (声明支持 Angular ^18.0.0)
- **Status**: ⚠️ 版本不匹配但可以运行

## 8.2 Known Issues | 已知问题

### Issue: d-form in Standalone Components
- **Problem**: `d-form` container component may not work in Angular 21 standalone components
- **Solution**: Use native `<form>` element with DevUI form sub-components (`d-form-item`, `d-form-label`, `d-form-control`)
- **Status**: Workaround implemented and working

### Working Components | 正常工作的组件
- ✅ `d-card` and sub-components
- ✅ `d-button`
- ✅ `d-text-input`
- ✅ `d-radio`
- ✅ `d-icon`
- ✅ `d-form-item`, `d-form-label`, `d-form-control`
- ✅ `d-layout` and sub-components

---

# 9. UPDATE LOG | 更新说明

UPDATE_LOG:
- v18.0.0: Current stable version, supports Angular ^18.0.0 (tested with Angular 21.1.0)
- Button: bsPosition deprecated, use ButtonGroup instead
- All components: Use module-based imports in standalone components
- Form: d-form container has compatibility issues in Angular 21 standalone components, use native form + DevUI sub-components
- 2026-02-07: Updated with comprehensive CSS variables, design tokens, and component specifications based on actual codebase usage

---

# 10. ADDITIONAL RESOURCES | 其他资源

## 10.1 Official Documentation | 官方文档
- Getting Started: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/get-start
- Component Overview: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/overview
- Design Tokens: https://devui.design/design-tokens/zh-cn/overview
- Design Color: https://devui.design/components/zh-cn/design-color/demo#color
- GitHub: https://github.com/DevCloudFE/ng-devui

## 10.2 Component Categories | 组件分类
- Basic: Button, Card, Icon, Badge, Avatar
- Form: TextInput, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Radio, Toggle, InputNumber, Slider, DatePicker, TimePicker, Upload, Form (sub-components)
- Data Display: DataTable, Tree, Pagination, Tags, Progress, Loading, Empty
- Feedback: Modal, Drawer, Toast, Alert, Tooltip, Popover
- Navigation: Menu, Tabs, Breadcrumb, Anchor, BackTop
- Layout: Layout, Splitter

## 10.3 Common Patterns | 常见模式

### Form with Validation (Hybrid Approach)
```typescript
<form class="devui-form">
  <d-form-item>
    <d-form-label class="required-label">* 用户名</d-form-label>
    <d-form-control>
      <d-text-input 
        [(ngModel)]="username"
        name="username"
        [required]="true"
        placeholder="请输入用户名">
      </d-text-input>
    </d-form-control>
  </d-form-item>
</form>
```

### Data Table with Pagination
```typescript
<d-data-table
  [dataSource]="dataSource"
  [columns]="columns"
  [pageable]="true"
  [pageSize]="10">
</d-data-table>
<d-pagination
  [total]="total"
  [pageSize]="10"
  [pageIndex]="currentPage"
  (pageIndexChange)="onPageChange($event)">
</d-pagination>
```

### Modal with Form
```typescript
<d-modal #modal>
  <d-modal-header>
    <h4>编辑</h4>
  </d-modal-header>
  <d-modal-body>
    <form class="devui-form">
      <d-form-item>
        <d-form-label>名称</d-form-label>
        <d-form-control>
          <d-text-input [(ngModel)]="name"></d-text-input>
        </d-form-control>
      </d-form-item>
    </form>
  </d-modal-body>
  <d-modal-footer>
    <d-button (btnClick)="modal.hide()">取消</d-button>
    <d-button bsStyle="primary" (btnClick)="handleSave()">保存</d-button>
  </d-modal-footer>
</d-modal>
```

### Card with Actions
```typescript
<d-card>
  <d-card-header>
    <d-card-title>卡片标题</d-card-title>
  </d-card-header>
  <d-card-content>
    卡片内容
  </d-card-content>
  <d-card-actions align="spaceBetween">
    <d-button bsStyle="text" bsSize="sm">操作1</d-button>
    <d-button bsStyle="text" bsSize="sm">操作2</d-button>
  </d-card-actions>
</d-card>
```
